GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Extensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading.

2. When practising Listening for Information Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information Public speaking.

6. When practising Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.

7. When practising Reading for details, which approach is best? (1 mark)

9. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Schule
   C. Buch
   D. Haus

10. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Good night
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Thank you

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive Reading Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
